Choose your program
Pursue a masterâs, PhD, diploma or certificate at Concordia to apply your skills creatively and practically. With nearly 130 graduate programs to choose from, youâre sure to find the fit for you.
Before applying, you should review the admission requirements and reach out to the Graduate Program Director for any questions you may have.
Application deadlines
Application deadlines vary by program. Priority will be given to complete applications submitted by the deadline. In some cases, programs may continue to accept applications if there is space available. See which programs are accepting applications.
If you are a U.S. and international student, we recommend that you apply as soon as possible considering the waiting period involved in receiving a study permit. We also strongly encourage you to submit supporting documents prior to the deadline.
